stem.text: The diagram shows part of the organisation of a DNA molecule and the associated histones.

stem.alt: Diagram of a DNA molecule wound around groups of histone proteins, with labels P, Q and R.

stem.text: Which statement about the features labelled P, Q and R during prophase of mitosis is correct?

A.text: The coiled DNA molecule forms Q and wraps around the histones of R to form small clusters held in place by histone P.

B.text: The groups of histones, P, and its associated DNA, Q, move closer together as the chromosome condenses around R.

C.text: The histones P and R are made of protein around which the DNA molecule, Q, is wrapped so that the DNA molecule can fit inside the nucleus.

D.text: The linked groups of histones P and R and the associated DNA, Q, form strands that fold and twist together to form a chromatid.
